source_text:
EXAM: Renal ultrasound.

HISTORY: Renal failure, neurogenic bladder, status-post cystectomy.

TECHNIQUE: Multiple ultrasonographic images of the kidneys were obtained in the transverse and longitudinal planes.

COMPARISON: Most recently obtained mm/dd/yy.

FINDINGS: The right kidney measures 12 x 5.2 x 4.6 cm and the left kidney measures 12.2 x 6.2 x 4.4 cm. The imaged portions of the kidneys fail to demonstrate evidence of mass, hydronephrosis or calculus. There is no evidence of cortical thinning.

Incidentally there is a rounded low-attenuation mass within the inferior aspect of the right lobe of the liver measuring 2.1 x 1.5 x 1.9 cm which has suggestion of some peripheral blood flow.

IMPRESSION:
1. No evidence of hydronephrosis.
2. Mass within the right lobe of the liver. The patient apparently has a severe iodine allergy. Further evaluation with MRI is recommended.
3. The results of this examination were given to XXX in Dr. XXX office on mm/dd/yy at XXX

adjudication_notes: Adjudicated from SC (Person 1) and RP (Person 2). Both captured the same content: renal ultrasound in a patient with renal failure, neurogenic bladder, and status-post cystectomy; right kidney 12 x 5.2 x 4.6 cm and left kidney 12.2 x 6.2 x 4.4 cm; no mass, hydronephrosis, or calculus and no cortical thinning; an incidental right hepatic lobe mass 2.1 x 1.5 x 1.9 cm with suggestion of peripheral blood flow; an apparent severe iodine allergy; and a recommendation for further MRI evaluation. Type conflicts resolved: the ultrasound FINDINGS (negative kidney findings, no cortical thinning, the liver mass, and its blood flow) are typed lab_value -- imaging results -- correcting an SC pass that had typed several of them procedure and agreeing with RP; the exam itself and 'status-post cystectomy' remain procedure. The MRI recommendation is typed instruction (a follow-up recommendation), agreeing with RP. RP split the negative kidney findings into three facts (mass / hydronephrosis / calculus); the combined fact is kept here, listing all three, with no loss of information. The imaging-technique sentence was dropped as methodology. The report's 'apparently' uncertainty on the iodine allergy is preserved.
